title: corrections-log.json
description: Public log of corrections applied (page /corrections-log/). One entry per applied request. It never holds requester data: no names, emails, roles or the text of the request. For a removal, company_id and company_name stay null (the listing is gone; naming it would publish who asked).

date.description: Date the correction was applied to the site.

what_changed.description: What changed on the site, in plain words, for example 'Renewal fee changed from $150 to $200.' Not the requester's message.
